services.name: Cabin Retreat
services.desc: Located within our park is a relaxing getaway space we like to call “The Retreat”. Overlooking Parkerson Mill Creek exists this space away from the hustle and bustle of a hotel but still with the same level of furnishings is close to everything that is Auburn and is most importantly private. The Retreat is perfect for Getaway weekends, Private meetings, Graduations, Weddings, or any occasion you can think of. The cabin is located at the top of the stairs above the office. The Living room is well appointed with a wonderful leather seating area and a 70 inch flat screen TV. The kitchen is a Kitchenaid Architect series dream kitchen even including a wine cooler. services.name: Package
services.desc: Returning Auburn RV Park package holders retain priority over their site for the 2026 season until December 1st 2025 when deposits on sites are due in order to hold their site for the 2026 season. For sites that we do not receive a deposit on they will be made available and opened up for reservations to persons already holding packages in the park on December 15th 2025 and then available to the general public on January 1st, 2026. For returning package holders if you are looking to upgrade or change sites within the park you can request a different site and put down a deposit on your current site and you will be notified of our ability to fill the request.
